prompt: Repair the refund batch endpoint across src/domain.cjs, src/service.cjs and src/route.cjs using company refund policy. Read CONTRACT.md and preserve exports. Domain solve(customer, plan, daysSincePurchase) returns refund eligibility; customer is Acme or Other, plan is annual or monthly, and daysSincePurchase is a nonnegative integer. Service solve(items) maps {id, customer, plan, daysSincePurchase} purchases to {id, eligible}. Route solve(request) validates and wraps the batch. Run node --test.

final_files.src/validate.cjs: exports.validate = request => !!request && Array.isArray(request.items) && request.items.every(item => !!item && typeof item.id === 'string' && ['Acme','Other'].includes(item.customer) && ['annual','monthly'].includes(item.plan) && Number.isInteger(item.daysSincePurchase) && item.daysSincePurchase >= 0);
